experiment_data.hypothesis: Extended GRPO Standard 7B from step 100 to 300. Tests whether longer GRPO training changes the recovery capacity gradient — does Standard eventually catch up to CKA-only, or does the gap persist/widen? If gap widens, confirms CKA-guided pruning creates a structural advantage that more training cannot compensate.
